name: Tomato Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Chop tomato, onion and green chilli.
Saute onion and green chilli in oil.
Cook until the tomato becomes soft.
Add cooked rice and mix well.
Cook for a few minutes and serve.

name: Lemon Rice
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool.
Heat oil and add mustard seeds and cumin.
Add cooked rice and mix gently.
Turn off the heat and add lemon juice.

name: Curd Rice
steps: Heat oil and add mustard seeds and cumin.
Add green chilli and saute briefly.
Mix the tempering with the curd rice.

name: Coconut Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Heat oil and add mustard seeds and cumin.
Add green chilli and grated coconut.

name: Tamarind Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Soak tamarind and extract the pulp.
Heat oil and add mustard seeds and peanuts.
Add cooked rice and mix well.
Cook for a few minutes and serve.

name: Jeera Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Add the cooked rice and salt.
Cook for two minutes and serve.

name: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Saute onion and cumin in oil.
Cover and cook until the rice is done.

name: Peas Pulao
steps: Cover and cook until the rice is done.

name: Mint Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Mix gently and cook for a few minutes.

name: Coriander Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Chop coriander, onion and green chilli.
Mix well and cook for a few minutes.

name: Mango Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Heat oil and add mustard seeds.

name: Peanut Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Heat oil and add mustard seeds and cumin.

name: Sesame Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Heat oil and add mustard seeds.
Add green chilli and sesame powder.

name: Egg Pulao
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Boil the eggs and peel them.
Mix gently and cook for a few minutes.

name: Vegetable Masala Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Add spices and cook until soft.
Add cooked rice and mix gently.

name: Corn Pulao
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.

name: Carrot Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Grate or finely chop the carrot.
Cook until the carrot is soft.
Add cooked rice and mix well.

name: Capsicum Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Add cooked rice and mix well.

name: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Wash and partially cook the basmati rice.
Saute onion and vegetables with spices.
Add tomato and cook the masala.
Layer the rice over the vegetable mixture.
Cover and cook on low heat until completely done.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Wash and pressure cook the dal.
Saute onion, tomato and green chilli.
Add the cooked dal and mix well.
Prepare a garlic and cumin tempering.

name: Palak Dal
steps: Simmer until the spinach is cooked.

name: Mixed Vegetable Dal
steps: Simmer until the vegetables are tender.

name: Moong Dal
steps: Wash and cook the moong dal.

name: Masoor Dal
steps: Wash and cook the masoor dal.

name: Chana Dal
steps: Pressure cook the dal until soft.
Saute onion, garlic and green chilli.

name: Tomato Pappu
steps: Cook the dal with tomatoes and turmeric.
Mix the tempering with the dal.

name: Gongura Pappu
steps: Wash and cook the gongura leaves.
Mash the dal and gongura together.
Prepare a tempering with oil, cumin and garlic.
Mix the tempering into the dal.

name: Vegetable Sambar
steps: Cook the vegetables with tomato and onion.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Prepare a mustard tempering and add it.

name: Tomato Sambar
steps: Cook tomatoes, onion and green chilli.

name: Drumstick Sambar
steps: Cook drumstick with tomato and onion.
Simmer until the drumstick is tender.

name: Rasam
steps: Cook the tomatoes and extract their pulp.

name: Tomato Rasam
steps: Cook the tomatoes and mash them.

name: Pepper Rasam
steps: Prepare a mustard and garlic tempering.

name: Spinach Dal
steps: Simmer until the spinach is cooked.

name: Vegetable Dal
steps: Simmer until the vegetables are tender.

name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Cut potato and cauliflower into pieces.

name: Aloo Palak
steps: Cook until the spinach is soft.

name: Matar Paneer
steps: Add spices and cook the masala.
Add a little water and simmer.

name: Jeera Aloo
steps: Add turmeric, chilli powder and salt.

name: Aloo Matar
steps: Cook until the peas are tender.

name: Beans Poriyal
steps: Heat oil and add mustard seeds.

name: Carrot Beans Poriyal
steps: Heat oil and add mustard seeds.

name: Potato Fry
steps: Add turmeric, chilli powder and salt.

name: Brinjal Fry
steps: Cut the brinjal into thin pieces.
Add turmeric, chilli powder and salt.

name: Bottle Gourd Curry
steps: Peel and chop the bottle gourd.

name: Egg Curry
steps: Boil the eggs and peel them.
Cook until the masala becomes soft.

name: Egg Masala
steps: Cook until the masala coats the eggs.

name: Egg Bhurji
steps: Beat the eggs in a bowl.

name: Egg Tomato Curry
steps: Add spices and cook the tomato.

name: Egg Coconut Curry
steps: Add coconut milk or coconut paste.

name: Egg Peas Masala
steps: Simmer until the peas are tender.

name: Egg Methi Curry
steps: Wash and chop the fenugreek leaves.

name: Chicken Curry
steps: Add water and simmer until the chicken is cooked.

name: Chicken Masala
steps: Cook until the masala coats the chicken.
Add water and simmer until cooked.

name: Chicken Pepper Fry
steps: Saute onion, garlic and green chilli.
Cook until the chicken is tender.

name: Chicken Tomato Curry
steps: Add spices and cook the masala.

name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Wash and soak the basmati rice.
Marinate the chicken with yogurt and spices.
Saute onion and cook the chicken masala.
Cook the rice separately until partly done.
Layer the rice over the chicken.
Add mint, coriander and fried onion.
Cover and cook on low heat until fully done.

name: Chicken Pulao
steps: Cover and cook until the rice and chicken are done.

name: Chicken Coconut Curry
steps: Add coconut milk or coconut paste.
Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked.

name: Chicken Andhra Curry
steps: Saute onion, garlic and green chilli.
Add water and simmer until tender.

name: Chicken Kadai
steps: Add a little water and simmer.

name: Chicken Potato Curry
steps: Clean the chicken and cut the potatoes.
Cover and cook until both are tender.

name: Chicken Green Curry
steps: Blend coriander, mint and green chilli.
Add the green paste and spices.
Add water and simmer until the chicken is tender.

name: Chicken Lemon Curry
steps: Saute onion, garlic and green chilli.
Cook until the chicken is tender.
Add a small amount of water.
Turn off the heat and add lemon juice.

name: Chicken Methi Curry
steps: Wash and chop the fenugreek leaves.

name: Vegetable Khichdi
steps: Wash the rice and moong dal.
Add water and cook until soft.

name: Vegetable Upma
steps: Saute mustard seeds, cumin, onion and green chilli.

name: Vegetable Poha
steps: Wash the poha and drain it.
Saute mustard seeds, cumin, onion and green chilli.
Mix well and cook for a few minutes.

name: Vegetable Pongal
steps: Wash the rice and moong dal.
Cook rice and dal together until soft.
Saute cumin, black pepper and ginger in ghee.

name: Bisi Bele Bath
steps: Cook the rice and toor dal until soft.
Mix the cooked dal and vegetables.

name: Palak Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it aside.
Saute cumin, onion and green chilli.
Add cooked rice and mix well.

name: Moong Dal Chilla
steps: Blend it into a smooth batter.
Add onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander.
Heat a pan and spread the batter.
Cook both sides until lightly crisp.

name: Besan Chilla
steps: Add gram flour to a bowl.
Add water to make a smooth batter.
Mix in onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander.
Spread the batter on a hot pan.

name: Vegetable Dal Dosa
steps: Blend them into a smooth batter.
Heat a pan and spread the batter.

name: Dal Khichdi
steps: Saute cumin, garlic and onion in ghee.
Add tomato, green chilli and turmeric.
Add water and cook until soft.
